assessments.reasoning: Directly inspected SAP SE material at the pinned or release-resolved locator. Captured bytes matched SHA-256 30dd01736dfac0ae82ae46ad7dd65462e4ef39ca4850fdc6981ca167487b45de and the cited source witness. The matched section was DATA - Inline Declaration, Effect paragraphs 1–3 and Notes. SAP documents a valid inline DATA declaration as taking effect during compilation even if the containing statement is never executed. The text forms a valid inline DATA declaration in a compatible position, with the required static operand type derivation. The documented form needs a compatible writing declaration position. An existing data object named data changes the interpretation of DATA(var) to substring access. The local-use guideline and static type requirement bound the applicable declaration form. The claim covers the declaration, with assignment and initialization effects outside its scope.
